<title level="1" right="Rules">[Carrying Items](/Rules.aspx?ID=2148)</title>

**Source** [Player Core](/Sources.aspx?ID=216) pg. 267

<row gap="medium">
<column gap="medium" flex="1 1 400px">
A character carries items in three ways: held, worn, and stowed. **Held items** are in your hands; a character typically has two hands, allowing them to hold an item in each hand or a single two-handed item using both hands. **Worn items** are tucked into pockets, belt pouches, bandoliers, weapon sheaths, and so forth, and they can be retrieved and returned relatively quickly. **Stowed items** are in a [backpack](/Equipment.aspx?ID=4) or a similar container, and they are more difficult to access.
</column>

<column gap="medium">

</column>

</row>
